subject: Remove empty list dead code condition in lmoveGenericCommand code (#3128)
reason: This is a pure dead-code removal refactor with no observable behavior change. The deleted branch in lmoveGenericCommand handled an existing key holding an empty (zero-length) list, but no client-reachable path can produce such a key: every list loader in rdb.c routes zero-element lists to `emptykey` and rdbLoad silently discards RDB_LOAD_ERR_EMPTY_KEY keys (the #8453 fix), RESTORE rejects an empty-list payload with 'Bad data format', and every command that empties a list calls dbDelete immediately.
